knock.name: Wall knocks
knock.desc: Someone in the next cell knocks on the wall: row and column of a letter in a grid

field.phraseHint: What gets knocked through the wall. A space is a pause between words; punctuation is dropped.
field.speedTip: Slow is easier to count; fast is harder but shorter.

problem.empty: Type a message: it will be knocked through the wall.
problem.tooLong: Too much to knock: {letters}, keep it to {max} at most. Shorten the message.

knock.swaps: These letters are not in the grid and are knocked as their neighbours: {list}.

table.how: first set of knocks — row, second — column

view.againTip: Knocking from the very beginning; the notes start over
view.recordTip: Dots appear on a scrap of paper with every knock
view.wall: Stone wall of the cell: the knocks come from here
view.hintFull: A set of knocks is the row, a pause, then the column. A longer pause is a new letter, longer still — a new word.
view.hintKnocks: Count the knocks: the first set is the row, the second is the column. Someone in your party has the grid.
view.hintTable: You only have the grid. The first set of knocks is the row, the second is the column.
